uncertain_terms.note: Source approval block is heavily garbled and mixed-language; the fragment 'رأس' before the name 'Ahmed Sawan' could not be rendered and was omitted. Names transliterated; roles inferred from context.
Stray fragment 'ال' at the start of the source sentence; omitted.
Source wording is garbled (literally 'set off the screwdrivers'); rendered 'Sets of screwdrivers and spanners'.
Rendered literally 'bed plate'; the exact part is uncertain.

Manifest language is 'ar', but only about 28% of the body characters are Arabic script; the body is predominantly English. The Arabic headings, labels and fragments were translated into English and the English body was carried over verbatim, including its spelling and grammar.
